title: SURE memory candidate proposal
description: artifacts/candidates/<nn>-<slug>/proposal.json (memory design spec 5.3). Documentation and test fixture only: proposals.py validates by hand and applies the ten gate rules; nothing loads this file at run time. cell.component must be a unit id of target_skill from units.json ('_' for facts and for skills without a state machine).

target_entry.description: entry id <target_skill>/<slug> for modify / supersede; null for add

applies_to.description: skills that may consume the entry; a bad_case must use exactly [target_skill]

trigger.description: literal substrings, at most config max_triggers_per_candidate; no '|', no ';', no 're:' prefix; see gate rule 4

causal.description: true when the entry claims a cause; then at least one evidence entry must be path:line

evidence.description: path or path:line relative to the run directory (.sure/runs/<run_id>/) or the target directory; no absolute paths, no '..'

digest_sha256.description: sha256 of artifacts/run_digest.json as built by the hook; gate rule 9 compares it with the checkpoint and the file on disk

scope.description: facts only: cluster | model_family:<name> | dataset:<name>; null for bad_case

checked_at.description: facts only: YYYY-MM-DD; null for bad_case
